statement: An office has two printers. Printer A prints $40$ pages per minute and printer B prints $25$ pages per minute. One morning both printers started at the same time, printer B ran $13$ minutes longer than printer A, and together they printed $2{,}275$ pages. For how many minutes did printer A run?

choices.misconception: I attached the extra 13 minutes to the faster printer, writing $25t + 40(t + 13) = 2{,}275$, and got 27.
I divided $2{,}275$ by the combined rate of 65 pages per minute and got 35, ignoring that printer B ran 13 extra minutes.
I solved the system correctly but gave the running time of printer B, $30 + 13 = 43$ minutes, instead of printer A.

hints: Let $t$ be the number of minutes printer A ran. Write printer B's time in terms of $t$.
Pages printed is rate times time for each printer. Add the two amounts and set the total equal to $2{,}275$.

solutions.elegant: In its $13$ extra minutes printer B printed $25 \times 13 = 325$ pages. The remaining $1{,}950$ pages were printed while both ran, at $65$ pages per minute, which takes $30$ minutes.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
